reports/heldout_natural.json.description: Natural human phrasing preserving all product types, constraints, and intent without quoting catalog listing templates verbatim.

reports/heldout_terse.json.description: Concise, punctuation-free, lowercase search keywords preserving core requirements.

reports/heldout_rambling.json.style: Chatty conversational text with contextual chatter
reports/heldout_rambling.json.description: Realistic customer backstories and context sentences preceding exact requirement specifications.

reports/heldout_typos.json.style: Natural chat with realistic typing mistakes
reports/heldout_typos.json.description: Natural phrasing with human keyboard slip typos, dropped apostrophes, transposed letters, and casual casing.

reports/heldout_indirect.json.description: Requirements expressed through physical utility, sensory feel, and functional descriptions rather than literal catalog vocabulary.

reports/heldout_lossy.json.description: Deliberately drops secondary constraints in multi-constraint messages and relaxes specific categories to broad parents to evaluate degradation.

reports/heldout_categories.json.description: Rewrites product-family names in opening messages across everyday names, synonyms, parents, children, and brand-led phrasing while keeping sentence frame intact.
